newsitem.title: USA: MedPlus sees conditional Q2 profitability.
newsitem.headline: MedPlus sees conditional Q2 profitability.

text.p: MedPlus Inc said Monday it "should return to profitability" in the second quarter, if revenues and margins improve as expected.
The company said it expects "a significant increase in revenues" in the second quarter.
MedPlus said the integration of the OptiMaxx and ChartMaxx products into one division is expected to be completed by the end of the second quarter.
The company said the consolidation and other cost-savings measures are expected to save as much as $200,000 to $300,000 per quarter by the third quarter.
Also Monday MedPlus reported a loss of $0.22 per share for the first quarter, ended March 31, compared with a loss of $0.06 per share for the same period last year.
